newsitem.title: GERMANY: German salesman bewildered by castration motives.
newsitem.headline: German salesman bewildered by castration motives.

text.p: A 27-year-old German whose testicles were cut off during an abortive robbery was quoted as saying on Tuesday the attacker was a woman he did not know and he was bewildered by her motives.
Holger Kronenthal, in an interview with the daily Express, said he was still in great pain from the attack on December 11 after a man and woman forced their way into his apartment and demanded money.
Enraged when he said he had only 50 marks ($32), they ordered him to drop his trousers and the woman pulled out a knife and castrated him, he reported.
"It was not an act of revenge. I didn't know either of the two attackers. I assume they were drug addicts." ($1=1.5653 Mark)
